Report on this task, now, to whoever dispatched you — in this session, in
prose. A Torque comment is the durable record; it is not delivery.

Write, in this order:

- **What landed.** Paths, and one clause each. Not a narrative of how you got
  there.
- **What did not**, and what is in the way. Work you left out is work you are
  reporting, not work you are hiding.
- **What you decided on your own authority.** Every judgment call the task did
  not settle for you, and which way you went.
- **What you would check first** if this turns out to be wrong.

Say a count only with the thing it counts. "Twenty tests pass" and "no findings"
are both claims a broken harness makes too.

Then stop. Do not commit, do not push, do not open a pull request, and do not
start the next thing.
